$comment: Experiment 5 (putting it all together: entangled pairs through the marked double slit) equations E1-E23 transcribed from docs/content/06-experiment-5-putting-it-all-together.md, plus helper equations for the maths check-ins (and_list_three, factor_common, trace_rule, survival_half, cross_term_rule, visibility_rule, exp3_vs_exp5, visibility_angles, p2_eraser_preview). Site ids: bell_state=E1, psi1_full=E2, propagation_signal=E3, propagation_idler=E4, psi2_screen=E5, path_difference=E6, spatial_amplitude=E7, intensity_derivation=E8, intensity_boxed_51=E9, psi1_expanded=E10, psi2_filtered_lost=E11, psi2_filtered=E12, which_path_idler=E13, psi3_screen_52=E14, intensity_sum_52=E15, intensity_boxed_52=E16, path_tags_52=E17, psi1_53=E18, p1_projection=E19, psi2_53=E20, path_tags_53=E21, intensity_sum_53=E22, intensity_boxed_53=E23. Rendered by tools/mathgen into app/assets/math/exp5/. \ket, \bra, \braket, \diag, \antidiag, \lost, \H, \V are built into mathgen.

equations.and_list_three: \underbrace{\ket{\V}_1}_{\text{signal pol.}}\;\underbrace{\ket{\V}_2}_{\text{idler pol.}}\;\underbrace{\ket{A}_1}_{\text{signal slit}}\;\underbrace{\ket{S}_2}_{\text{idler place}} \;=\; \text{``signal } \V \text{ and idler } \V \text{ and slit } A \text{ and idler at } S\text{''}
equations.trace_rule: I(y) \;\propto\; \big|\mathcal{A}_{\V}(y)\big|^{2} + \big|\mathcal{A}_{\H}(y)\big|^{2} \qquad \text{(D}_1\text{ never asks the idler: both idler outcomes are added)}
equations.which_path_idler: \text{Idler } \ket{\V}_2 \Rightarrow \text{signal went through } A, \qquad \text{Idler } \ket{\H}_2 \Rightarrow \text{signal went through } B.
equations.exp3_vs_exp5: \begin{aligned} \text{Exp. 3:}\quad e^{ika}\ket{\H} + e^{ikb}\ket{\V} \;&\xrightarrow{\;P_1 = 45^{\circ}\;}\; \big(e^{ika} + e^{ikb}\big)\ket{\diag} \\ \text{Exp. 5:}\quad e^{ika}\VV + e^{ikb}\HH \;&\xrightarrow{\;P_1 = 45^{\circ}\;}\; \ket{\diag}_1\big(e^{ika}\ket{\V}_2 + e^{ikb}\ket{\H}_2\big) \end{aligned}
equations.p2_eraser_preview: I_{c}(y) \propto \tfrac{1}{8}\Big[1 + \sin(2\theta)\,\cos\Big(\frac{2\pi d y}{\lambda L}\Big)\Big] \qquad\text{(coincidences, } P_2 \text{ at angle } \theta \text{ on the idler)}
